effects: AoE and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
AoE abilities deal 5% more damage per target size dimension.
body.name: Splash Zone

assumptions: Only explicitly tagged AoE and multi-target attacks qualify; the two bonuses are additive with each other.
The per-size bonus applies to AoE only and uses the target's size dimension. A size-5 target grants five 5% steps regardless of occupied footprint data.
Occupied tiles and targets in area remain separate scenario fields for spatial coverage and multi-target mechanics.
Blessing-generated damage is excluded except Grasp of Guthix, whose disclosed 3x3 poison hit is treated as AoE.

effects: Damage over time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit of a qualifying damage over time ability triggers a Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp of Guthix deals one poison hit in a 3x3 area: 80-120% of poison ability damage plus 20-30% of maximum life points.
body.name: Tearing Thorns

assumptions: Qualifying DoT abilities are explicitly marked in the combat ability catalogue; poison ticks, conjure and familiar damage, converted channels, and equipment procs are excluded.
The duration extension doubles the number of scheduled DoT hits at the ability's declared cadence; it does not alter tick cadence or damage bands.
Enhanced Kerapac's wrist wraps can detonate Combust's 20 Tearing Thorns hits together; the fifth, tenth, fifteenth, and twentieth hits each trigger Grasp.
Grasp is one poison hit. The separately floored ability-damage and maximum-life terms are added before poison and AoE modifiers, poison immunity blocks the whole hit, and Big Boned can attach once.
The 3x3 target count is the resolved area-target scenario capped at 9.

effects: Poison damage is increased by 50%, plus an additional 2% per Herblore level.
Damaging an enemy disables their poison immunity for 30 seconds.
body.name: Envenomed

assumptions: The selected Herblore level is clamped to the skill's 1-120 range; poison damage is multiplied by 1.5 plus 0.02 per level.
The multiplier applies to the entire combined Grasp poison hit, including its maximum-life term.
Every positive-damage hit starts or refreshes a 50-tick half-open poison-immunity override. The triggering hit can apply poison after the override is set, enabling the entire Grasp hit.

body.name: Perfidious

The two-reduction threshold applies only to the original Barkscales incoming-damage counter; Tearing Thorns remains a five-DoT-hit counter.
